pages.text: Cataclysm's bosses wait at the bottom of great dungeons in every dimension: the Netherite Monstrosity, the Ender Guardian, the Harbinger, the Ancient Remnant, the Leviathan, Scylla, Maledictus, and Ignis.
Some sleep until you wake them. Craftable eyes point to their lairs.
From Ignis. Makes some of the best armor in the pack.
